A spring, which obeys Hooke’s law, has an unstretched length of 10cm.
A load of 20N is suspended from the spring.
The new length of the spring is 36cm.
What is the spring constant k of the spring?
A
0.56N/cm
B
0.77N/cm
C
1.3N/cm
D
1.8N/cm
subject: Physics
